title: Your Scheduled Task Stays Asleep
caption:
I run a scheduled Claude Code session every morning, so this one landed badly.

October 5: 2.1.290 fixed cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending /loop wakeup. October 7: 2.1.293 reverted it. The changelog's own words: "Claude is no longer told, and the session stays asleep."

The asymmetry is what I can't unsee. A day later, 2.1.295 fixed the same silence for local background sessions, where "the session now says so and Claude is told." Cloud never got it back, and 2.1.296 is still the current release.

A silent no-op is worse than a crash, so I check my routine actually ran now. Do you check your automations ran?

slides.title: The Two-Day Round Trip
items: Oct 5: 2.1.290 fixes it. Claude is told, and can reschedule.
Oct 7: 2.1.293 reverts it. Claude is no longer told.
